domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers GRC Overview concepts including positioning, framework structure, key terminology, and technical details across 12.0% of the exam content to ensure a proper initial understanding of the platform.

This domain focuses on Policy and Compliance Management record lifecycles, architecture, configuration, and supporting processes that govern organizational policies and ensure proper regulatory compliance controls are established across the enterprise.

study_focus: Risk and Advanced Risk Record Lifecycles
domain_guidance.summary: This domain examines Risk Management record lifecycles, architecture, and configuration settings that allow implementers to identify, assess, and manage operational risks effectively within the ServiceNow platform environment during projects.

This domain addresses the Entity Framework including entity scoping, entity type approach, class approach, and architecture to correctly categorize and target organizational assets for risk assessments and compliance monitoring.

This domain focuses on continuous authorization and monitoring elements within the GRC application architecture to maintain ongoing visibility into organizational security postures and control effectiveness across business operations.

study_focus: Audit and Advanced Audit Personas, Groups, and Roles
domain_guidance.summary: This specific domain comprehensively covers Audit Management lifecycles, architecture, and related roles that support internal and external audit execution, evidence gathering, and finding remediation processes across various organizational departments.

This specific domain addresses common GRC foundation elements across platform capabilities and regulatory change management to ensure seamless integration with broader enterprise workflows and updates during implementation cycles.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Arrive at the Pearson test center or set up your OnVUE online proctored environment early. Read each of the 60 questions carefully, noting whether single or multiple selections are required.

faq.answer_text: The certification exam consists of exactly 60 questions, delivered in multiple-choice and multiple-select formats to evaluate your implementation knowledge across all specified domains during the testing session.
faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?

faq.answer_text: The exam utilizes a straightforward pass or fail outcome based on a predetermined cut score that is evaluated directly against your overall performance on the test.
You are given a total duration of 90 minutes to complete all questions on the exam once the testing timer officially begins during your scheduled session.
You should study using official ServiceNow training materials, the official ServiceNow Product documentation site, and the official ServiceNow developer site to ensure complete coverage of topics.

editorial.overview: The ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist - Risk and Compliance certification confirms your ability to configure, implement, and maintain ServiceNow Risk, Policy & Compliance, and Audit Management applications. Certified by ServiceNow, the 90-minute exam evaluates your skills across seven distinct domains using 60 questions to ensure you are fully prepared for implementation projects.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review official ServiceNow training materials, the ServiceNow Product documentation site, and the ServiceNow developer site in exhaustive detail. Complete the recommended GRC training courses and practice using official resources before booking your exam through Pearson to ensure complete readiness across all tested topics and domains.
editorial.who_should_take: The exam is intended for ServiceNow customers, partners, and employees who have six months of field experience participating in at least two ServiceNow deployment projects or maintaining ServiceNow instances.
